title: SimplyCubed Skill Config
description: Authored metadata for one listed Agent Skill (the open, cross-tool SKILL.md format read by Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, and others). The skill source is referenced (not vendored) at an immutable upstream commit SHA. Certification/scan results are produced by CI into <slug>.scan.json and are NOT authored here.

slug.description: URL/install slug and plugin name; must match the filename. In Claude Code, install is /plugin install <slug>@simplycubed; for other agents the skill folder installs into the agent's skills directory (e.g. .agents/skills/).

description.description: One-line description shown in the catalog.

status.description: Only 'active' skills are published to the marketplace + storefront. 'revoked' = pulled after a later safety failure (its snapshot is removed too).

sha.description: Full 40-hex commit SHA. Immutable pin: never a tag or branch. Certification and install both bind to this exact commit.

path.description: Optional subdirectory within the repo when the skill lives in a subfolder (no leading/trailing slash).

license.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream skill's license. Permissive licenses only; copyleft and unlicensed are rejected.

homepage.description: Optional canonical homepage/source URL (defaults to the upstream repo).

tier.description: Optional; defaults to 'free'. 'premium' = subscription-gated (excluded from the public plugin manifest; delivered through the entitlement service, not this repo).

warning.description: Optional, narrow exception lane for a specifically approved skill that stays listed with a warning on the storefront despite known, named blocking findings. The warning text is public; the allowed findings are the exact blocking findings this one skill is permitted to carry.

title.description: Optional short warning heading for the storefront.

summary.description: Short public warning line suitable for compact UIs such as plugin descriptions.

message.description: Public warning shown on the skill page.

recommendation.description: Optional public recommendation for the safer path a user should take instead.
